cases.title: A handler is called once per invocation
cases.when: An invocation fails after the handler starts
then: The SDK never re-invokes the handler

cases.title: Input is validated before the handler
then: INVALID_ARGUMENT and the handler is not called

cases.title: Input and output limits are enforced
cases.when: Inputs of 1 MiB + 1 byte and outputs of 4 MiB + 1 byte
then: Both are refused with the documented errors

cases.title: maxConcurrency queues up to 1 s, then fails
cases.when: maxConcurrency 1 with two concurrent calls, the first taking 2 s
then: The second fails with CONCURRENCY_LIMIT after about 1 s

cases.title: The deadline is request time plus maxDurationMs, capped
cases.when: A sync tool with maxDurationMs 120000, and a caller credential expiring in 10 s
then: Effective deadline is the lowest of maxDurationMs, the platform ceiling and credential expiry

cases.title: Cancellation ends CANCELLED after the grace period
cases.when: A handler ignores cancellation for 10 s
then: After 5 s the handler is abandoned (standalone) or killed (governed)
Outcome CANCELLED and any later result discarded

cases.title: No state survives between invocations
cases.when: Two invocations in one standalone process, the first writing to a static field
then: The SDK provides no API that carries state; the mode-equivalence suite compares outputs

cases.title: Concurrent invocations do not share context
cases.when: Two concurrent invocations read their own arguments and invocation ids
